title: PE Teacher, SEMH School
summary: Use sport to build confidence, teamwork and wellbeing at a specialist SEMH school. Temp to perm.
body:
## The position

Bright Futures is working in partnership with a specialist SEMH school in north Essex to recruit a passionate, resilient PE teacher for an immediate start. The role is initially temporary, with excellent rates of pay and a strong possibility of a permanent position for the right candidate.

It's a fantastic opportunity to make a real difference to young people who need additional social, emotional and mental health support. The school provides a structured, supportive environment where PE plays an important part in developing confidence, teamwork, resilience and positive wellbeing.

## Key responsibilities

- Deliver engaging, inclusive PE lessons to students with SEMH needs.
- Adapt teaching strategies to a range of learning styles and behaviours.
- Use sport and physical activity to build confidence, motivation and positive relationships.
- Work closely with support staff and the wider school team to keep students engaged in learning.
- Promote positive behaviour and wellbeing through structured physical activity.

## The ideal candidate

- Qualified Teacher Status (QTS) or a relevant teaching qualification.
- Experience teaching PE at secondary level.
- Experience with SEMH, SEND or challenging behaviour (highly desirable).
- Strong classroom and behaviour management skills.
- A patient, resilient and proactive approach to supporting young people.

## What Bright Futures offers

- Excellent rates of pay.
- An immediate start.
- Support from a dedicated education recruitment team.
- The opportunity to secure a permanent role in a supportive SEMH setting.
- Access to specialist education roles across Essex and east London.
